title: Equipment Lease Agreement

issues.why: Body text is Arial; house rule 9 requires Aptos.
Body text is 10 point; house rule 9 requires 12 point.
"ARTICLE I" with "Section 1.01" numbering; house rule 3 uses I. for articles and A. for sections.
issues.fix: I. LEASE AND TERM; A. Lease; B. Term; and so on.

issues.quote: This equipment lease agreement is dated 1/15/2027 and is between Tamarind Equipment Finance Corp., a Colorado corporation ("Lessor"), and Greywater Excavation, LLC, a Colorado limited liability company ("Lessee").
WHEREAS, Lessee wishes to lease from Lessor the excavation equipment in Schedule A (the "Equipment"), and Lessor is willing to lease the Equipment to Lessee on the terms of this lease.
issues.fix: Delete WHEREAS; state the background as a plain sentence.

issues.quote: The term of this lease (the "Term") shall commence on the date on which the Equipment arrives at Lessee's yard and shall continue for sixty (60) months.
issues.why: No duty: "shall commence ... and shall continue" states a policy about the term.
issues.fix: The term of this lease (the "Term") begins on the date on which the Equipment arrives at Lessee's yard and continues for 60 months.

issues.quote: The term of this lease (the "Term") shall commence on the date on which the Equipment arrives at Lessee's yard and shall continue for sixty (60) months.
The Equipment shall be delivered to Lessee's yard at 2100 Quarry Road, Golden, Colorado 80401, no later than February 15, 2027.
issues.why: Passive hides who must deliver the Equipment.
issues.fix: Lessor shall deliver the Equipment to Lessee's yard at ...

issues.quote: Lessee must pay Lessor rent of $4,850 per month (the "Rent").
issues.why: "must" used for a duty of a party that is the subject.
issues.fix: Lessee shall pay Lessor rent of $4,850 per month (the "Rent").

issues.quote: Rent for each calendar month is due and payable before that month begins.
If Lessee shall fail to pay any Rent when due, Lessee shall pay Lessor a late charge equal to 5% of the overdue amount.
issues.fix: If Lessee fails to pay any Rent when due, ...

issues.quote: Time is of the essence of this lease.
issues.why: MSCD 13.884: say what happens on a missed deadline instead.
issues.fix: Delete; the late charge in the section titled "Late Payment" already states the consequence.

issues.quote: At the end of the Term, Lessee shall return the Equipment to Lessor at Lessor's yard in Denver, Colorado, in the condition that Section 3.02 hereof requires, except for ordinary wear.
issues.fix: in the condition that the section titled "Maintenance" requires

issues.quote: At the end of the Term, Lessee shall return the Equipment to Lessor at Lessor's yard in Denver, Colorado, in the condition that Section 3.02 hereof requires, except for ordinary wear.
Lessee shall indemnify and hold harmless Lessor from any and all claims arising out of or relating to Lessee's use of the Equipment.
Lessee shall indemnify and hold harmless Lessor from any and all claims arising out of or relating to Lessee's use of the Equipment.

issues.anchor: arising out of or relating to
issues.quote: Lessee shall indemnify and hold harmless Lessor from any and all claims arising out of or relating to Lessee's use of the Equipment.
All provisions of this lease that by their nature should survive termination shall survive termination.
issues.why: Vague survival clause (MSCD 13.822-13.831); it also uses "should".
issues.fix: Delete; state which obligations survive termination and for how long.

traps.quote: WHEREAS, Lessee wishes to lease from Lessor the excavation equipment in Schedule A (the "Equipment"), and Lessor is willing to lease the Equipment to Lessee on the terms of this lease.
traps.why_correct: Correct schedule: lettered, and it holds a list of equipment that the body refers to.

traps.anchor: the date on which the Equipment arrives
traps.quote: The term of this lease (the "Term") shall commence on the date on which the Equipment arrives at Lessee's yard and shall continue for sixty (60) months.

traps.anchor: Lessor is not required to repair
traps.quote: Lessor is not required to repair the Equipment.
traps.why_correct: House exception to active voice: "is not required to" (MSCD 3.292).

traps.quote: LESSOR MAKES NO WARRANTY, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING ANY IMPLIED WARRANTY OF MERCHANTABILITY OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
traps.why_correct: UCC disclaimer that the statute requires: UCC Section 2A-214 requires an exclusion of the implied warranty of merchantability to mention merchantability and, in a writing, to be conspicuous. Keep the capitals. Settled policy: statutory wording stays; a note that flags it while keeping it unchanged is acceptable, but rewriting or lowercasing it is an error.

traps.quote: Lessor hereby leases the Equipment to Lessee for the Term.
traps.why_correct: Language of performance uses "hereby" with the simple present (MSCD 3.48-3.50); "hereby" is not on the archaic list.

notes: Other side's legacy template.  Formatting issues are Arial 10 only; paragraphs are left-aligned and headings are not underlined.  Party names ("Lessor", "Lessee") correctly have no article.  Spacing is compliant.
